cards.title_ko: 병변의 원료가 만들어지는 곳을 겨냥하기
cards.when_to_use: A harmful circulating protein or metabolite has an identified production tissue.
cards.principle: Generate an upstream production-suppression hypothesis alongside treating the damaged tissue; test the production-to-disease link in steps.

falsifier_template.H1: Suppressing production of X in tissue T lowers downstream injury readout Y under condition C.
falsifier_template.H0: With equally verified delivery, lowering X does not improve Y under C.
falsifier_template.single_changed_variable: Target-X siRNA versus non-targeting siRNA
falsifier_template.readout: X suppression plus prespecified downstream Y; report each separately
falsifier_template.timepoint: Specify target-response and disease-response windows before testing
falsifier_template.refuting_result: X is adequately reduced but Y shows a precise lack of the prespecified improvement.
falsifier_template.experiment_failure: Delivery or X assay fails; Y cannot be interpreted.

next_actions.supports: Retain the bounded link; replicate with an independent perturbation before extending to clinical benefit.
next_actions.refutes: Revise this causal link or its stated conditions; retain alternatives consistent with the readout.
next_actions.inconclusive: Resolve the named precision, timing or compartment uncertainty before choosing between H1 and H0.
next_actions.experiment_failure: Repair the failed assay, exposure or control and repeat the same contrast.

cards.when_to_use: A defective metabolic step accumulates a harmful product and another enzyme supplies its precursor.
cards.principle: Generate substrate-reduction and terminal-production hypotheses rather than assuming the missing enzyme must be repaired.

falsifier_template.H1: Reducing enzyme X activity lowers harmful flux Y despite the unchanged primary defect.
falsifier_template.H0: Adequate reduction of X leaves Y unchanged under the same substrate conditions.
falsifier_template.single_changed_variable: X suppression versus matched non-targeting control
falsifier_template.readout: X engagement, precursor and product quantified separately
falsifier_template.timepoint: Prespecify after steady-state exposure and matched collection
falsifier_template.refuting_result: X is reduced and the assay recovers product, but harmful flux does not decline with adequate precision.
falsifier_template.experiment_failure: Failed collection, altered clearance or no X suppression prevents flux inference.

cards.title_ko: 부족한 성분을 보충하는 대신 반대 경로를 조절하기
cards.when_to_use: A missing function is opposed by a measurable endogenous brake.
cards.principle: Generate a compensation hypothesis: reducing the opposing process may restore balance without replacing the deficient component.

falsifier_template.H1: At the fixed exposure, reducing opposing process X restores functional readout Y by a prospectively justified amount.
falsifier_template.H0: Adequate X reduction does not achieve that functional improvement under these conditions.
falsifier_template.single_changed_variable: Partial X suppression versus non-targeting control
falsifier_template.readout: Functional output and excess-correction safety readout, separately
falsifier_template.timepoint: Specify engagement window and downstream challenge time
falsifier_template.refuting_result: With valid controls and adequate X reduction, the uncertainty interval excludes the required functional improvement. Excess correction is a separate safety decision, not erasure of activity.
falsifier_template.experiment_failure: Failed engagement or dysfunctional challenge assay.

next_actions.supports: Retain the activity observation. Separately assess excess-correction safety; active but unsafe does not support escalation. Test any degree-of-suppression change as a new controlled contrast.

falsifier_template.refuting_result: Adequate X inhibition produces no selective deficit in D cells with sufficient precision.
falsifier_template.experiment_failure: D status or X engagement fails verification.

falsifier_template.H0: Treatment effect does not differ by B after the same comparison.

falsifier_template.timepoint: Prespecified common outcome window
falsifier_template.refuting_result: Reliable B classification and exposure show a precise absence of the proposed interaction.
falsifier_template.experiment_failure: Unreliable biomarker classification or missing comparator prevents the test.

falsifier_template.experiment_failure: Inadequate sample or unreliable R assay; absence cannot be distinguished from assay failure.

falsifier_template.refuting_result: At matched X engagement, C fails the predeclared efficacy or liability improvement criterion.
falsifier_template.experiment_failure: Unable to match/verify X engagement or to measure Z-dependent liability.

source_refs.title: ABT-199, a potent and selective BCL-2 inhibitor, achieves antitumor activity while sparing platelets

worked_examples.observation_to_decision: Family selectivity was engineered to retain antitumor activity while sparing platelets.
worked_examples.limits: Initial human activity was uncontrolled; platelet sparing does not remove other safety hazards.

cards.operationalization_note: Matched engagement may require differing concentrations. Record compound identity and concentration explicitly; this can test a matched-engagement regimen, but is not a one-factor molecular identity comparison. Use separate equal-concentration contrasts or a clearly scoped dose-response analysis; do not hide the second change.

cards.when_to_use: A disease-linked protein state exposes a selectively addressable chemical feature.

falsifier_template.H1: Binding feature F with C selectively suppresses the disease-linked state of X.
falsifier_template.H0: C binding does not selectively suppress that state or acts independently of F.

controls: F-altered reference tested as a separate context
falsifier_template.readout: Occupancy then proximal signaling then phenotype
falsifier_template.timepoint: Predefine sequential windows
falsifier_template.refuting_result: Verified occupancy leaves proximal function unchanged, or matched control reproduces the effect without F.
falsifier_template.experiment_failure: Binding assay fails or exposure is insufficient.

falsifier_template.H1: One specified regimen maintains X suppression and downstream Y through the proposed interval.

falsifier_template.refuting_result: Reproducible loss of engagement or Y control before the intended interval contradicts durability.
falsifier_template.experiment_failure: Missed dose or unreliable trough sampling invalidates the interval test.

cards.when_to_use: A combination has a mechanistic rationale but its added contribution is unknown.
cards.principle: Keep the backbone identical and test one added component; a whole-regimen comparison cannot identify both components separately.

falsifier_template.H1: Adding B to fixed A improves Y versus fixed A alone.
